pages.title: Fillwords: Word Search
pages.creator: MALPA GAMES LTD
pages.description:
Fillwords: Word Search asks you to turn a letter grid into a complete set of hidden words. Link adjacent letters to spell words, covering the whole board so that no cells remain unused. Finding one word is only part of the puzzle: its path must also fit with the words around it.

Work through the levels by examining letter combinations and the spaces left behind. Familiar word beginnings and endings can help you spot a possible answer, while letters along the edges offer another place to start searching.

pages.title: Night Lake
pages.creator: SolidBuild
pages.description: Fish from a small boat after dark in Night Lake. Row to a spot, cast the line, and react when the float dips before reeling in the catch. Manage line tension, sell fish at the dock, and upgrade equipment for further lake exploration.

pages.title: Hexshot ARENA
pages.creator: Xorgeneric
pages.description: Fight through destructible voxel arenas in Hexshot ARENA. Choose a hero class, raise cover, and break through walls as you use weapons and abilities. Play against bots or online opponents in modes ranging from team battles to control-point and payload matches.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Fruits
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Clear matching fruit formations in Bubble Shooter Fruits. Aim bubbles into groups of at least three identical fruits and use wall rebounds to reach awkward gaps. Complete the required clears to advance through increasingly difficult boards.

pages.title: Kingdom Wars
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Combine defensive structures in Kingdom Wars. Merge facilities, traps, and turrets to strengthen your setup against approaching enemies. Space is limited, making the placement and improvement of each defensive piece part of the battle plan.

pages.title: Brick Breaker
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Launch volleys at descending targets in Brick Breaker. Aim to chain hits, collect effects such as extra balls and shields, and clear the formation before it reaches the bottom. Different stage layouts and recurring boss fights alter the shooting challenge.

pages.title: Annoying Boss Punch Game
pages.creator: Terafort US LLC
pages.description: Cause cartoon office chaos in Annoying Boss Punch Game. Use punches, kicks, and special items against the fictional boss, combining quick clicks into attacks. Move around the scene and aim stronger actions as you work through the encounters.

pages.title: Word Search Universe Animals
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find creature names in Word Search Universe Animals. Drag across the letter grid horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, checking both reading directions. Complete every listed word to unlock the next level and explore further groups of animals.

pages.title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
pages.creator: GamesMrkt
pages.description: Build a bakery business in My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve. Bake and stack doughnuts, serve arriving customers, and clean the floors between tasks. Upgrade machines and unlock additional locations as the operation grows into a larger chain.

pages.title: Popcat Clicker
pages.creator: PCC
pages.description: Tap a cat to earn currency in Popcat Clicker. Spend the coins on upgrades and boosters that improve the income from the activity. Keep developing the cat through successive levels and unlock further features as your earnings grow.

pages.title: Knit Bears
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Finish knitted toys in Knit Bears by selecting an available outlined bear. Matching yarn from the bottom row wraps around it, with three yarns needed for completion. Plan choices carefully, because too many unfinished bears can fill the board and end the game.

pages.title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create themed party outfits in Iconic Halloween Costumes. Style three friends with clothing, accessories, and makeup inspired by recognizable fantasy and pop-culture looks. Mix the available pieces into individual costumes, from glamorous gowns to cowgirl fashion.

pages.title: Jungle Fury Mutant Rhino Mayhem
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: Rescue villagers from mutant warriors in Jungle Fury Mutant Rhino Mayhem. Move, jump, and fight through swamps, caves, and fortified areas using bows, axes, and other weapons. Buy improvements from the blacksmith before confronting stronger rhino enemies and bosses.

pages.title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Grow a movie-theater business in Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon. Start with a small screening room and unlock ticket booths, additional halls, dining spaces, and other facilities. Hire employees to help manage the expanding cinema and its customer service.

pages.title: Shoot And Drive
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Escape a bandit trap in Shoot And Drive. Explore on foot, use firearms against enemies, and enter a vehicle when the route calls for driving. Switch weapons and keep moving through the struggle for survival in a radiation-stricken world.

pages.title: Doge Bubble
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Free the trapped character bubbles in Doge Bubble. Aim shots to make matching groups of at least three and clear the formations. Rockets, bombs, and multicolored bubbles provide different ways to open a route through difficult layouts.

pages.title: The Sort Agency
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear a cluttered collection in The Sort Agency. Select three identical objects to make them disappear and gather everything shown on the task list. Watch how many items you are holding so your selections keep room available for further matches.

pages.title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Clear exposed cards in Galactic Golf Solitaire. Move a card onto the discard pile when it is one rank above or below the top card, regardless of suit. Draw from the stock when needed and work toward emptying all seven columns.

pages.title: Stop The Bullet
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Draw a barrier to protect a stick figure in Stop The Bullet. Shape your line to redirect the incoming shot before it reaches the character. Bullets rebound from surfaces, so a careless defense can send the danger back toward the person you meant to save.

pages.title: Brain Find Can You Find It
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Find the requested object through unconventional solutions in Brain Find Can You Find It. Inspect each puzzle, interact with its elements, and reconsider the obvious answer when it fails. The challenges combine discovery with memory, quick reactions, and unusual logic.

pages.title: Ragdoll Arena 2 Player
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Compete in short physics contests in Ragdoll Arena 2 Player. Choose activities such as fruit slicing, hammer battles, or rooftop shooting and reach three points before the opponent. Play against the computer or a friend and spend earned coins on character customization.

pages.title: Human Ball 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Build a rolling mass of people in Human Ball 3D. Steer through favorable gates to gather more humans, then crash through obstacles and opponents. Collect coins during the run and use them to improve your progression between attempts.

pages.title: Circuit Challenge
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Race open-wheel cars in Circuit Challenge. Compete across eight tracks and finish among the top three to open the next circuit. Use keyboard steering and a boost while working toward qualifying performances on every course.

pages.title: Abandoned Lab
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Stop a robotic attack in Abandoned Lab. Explore the facility, shoot Dr Robo's machines, and work toward destroying the laboratory. Move with the arrow keys and fire with the mouse as you clear the robots threatening humanity.

pages.title: Halloween Collect
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Draw chains of matching seasonal pieces in Halloween Collect. Link at least three adjacent items horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to collect them. Longer chains provide bonuses, helping you gather each level's requested objects before time expires.

pages.title: Bee Careful
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Guide an insect through incoming fire in Bee Careful. Move the bee vertically to avoid bullets during a five-minute approach toward its attacker. Survive the journey without being hit so you can reach the creature and sting it.

pages.title: Slither Dragon.io
pages.creator: Bizogames.com
pages.description: Grow a serpentine creature in Slither Dragon.io. Eat multicolored eggs, avoid rival dragons' bodies, and use the speed control when needed. The objective is to become the longest dragon while keeping your own head clear of fatal collisions.

pages.title: Math Games
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Work through a sequence of arithmetic activities in Math Games. Eight game types present problems involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Select answers using the screen controls and continue through the different exercises.

pages.title: Tower Defense
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Protect a castle from monsters in Tower Defense. Place towers where they can cover useful stretches of the enemies' route, then upgrade them to improve the defense. Keep adapting the setup as different creatures attack the stronghold.

pages.title: Cute Monster Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Aim colored shots in Cute Monster Bubble Shooter. Join groups of three or more matching bubbles to clear them, trying to finish with fewer shots. Drag to change the direction, then release when the trajectory reaches the target you want.

pages.title: Pink Cuteman 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cross snow-covered stages in Pink Cuteman 2. Avoid enemies, flying bats, cliffs, and water while guiding the character toward the flag. Use the double jump to handle difficult crossings and reach the next level safely.

pages.title: Fishing and Lines
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Catch fish by solving a colored-ball puzzle in Fishing and Lines. Move balls between cells to make horizontal, vertical, or diagonal lines of at least three identical pieces. The colors and combinations determine which fish species your matching produces.

pages.title: SHADOWS GAME
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Identify concealed pictures from silhouettes in SHADOWS GAME. Inspect the shadow and choose the corresponding image from the available answers. The activity centers on recognizing an object's outline and linking it to its complete appearance.

pages.title: Farm Heroes Match
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Fight garden pests through tile matching in Farm Heroes Match. Swap pieces into matching groups to charge the corresponding hero's powers, then attack harmful insects. Work quickly before the countdown ends to build a higher score.

pages.title: Merry Christmas Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble seasonal illustrations in Merry Christmas Puzzle. Choose among six images and four piece counts, from sixteen to one hundred. Fit each section into place to complete the holiday picture at your selected difficulty.

pages.title: Tank Battle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Outmaneuver another armored vehicle in Tank Battle. Collect ammunition and power-ups, navigate toward the enemy, and fire before it destroys you. A shared-device two-player option lets a friend control the opposing tank.

pages.title: Convertible Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together open-top vehicle pictures in Convertible Cars Jigsaw. Choose an easy, medium, or hard puzzle and drag the sections into position. Twelve images offer different cars to rebuild, with the hardest setting using one hundred pieces.

pages.title: Roll Color
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Create pictures by unrolling colored layers in Roll Color. Tap to roll out the available sections and reveal the illustration. Work through each design by choosing the rolling actions needed to bring its colored parts into place.

pages.title: Cupcake Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Assemble dessert illustrations in Cupcake Puzzle. Move the scattered picture pieces into their proper positions to rebuild the cupcake scene. Compare the shapes and decorations across the sections as you complete each sweet-themed image.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Letters
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color alphabet-themed pictures in Easy Kids Coloring Letters. Select a drawing and apply colors to its outlined areas with mouse or touch input. The activity combines simple painting choices with letter illustrations, letting you create different versions of each picture.

pages.title: Football Flick
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Challenge another footballer in Football Flick. Choose from twelve players and compete in one-on-one matches, moving with the arrow keys and shooting with F. Work the ball past the opponent while trying to keep your own goal protected.

pages.title: Cute Animal Ride Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match illustrated pieces in Cute Animal Ride Match 3. Arrange at least three of the same color in a line to earn points. Keep the side gauge from falling too low by continuing to make successful matches.

pages.title: Galactic Judge
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight space pirates in Galactic Judge. Pilot an armed fighter through hostile groups, upgrade its armor and weapons, and aim to clear every enemy in a level. Achievements provide additional goals alongside completing the combat stages.

pages.title: Space Adventure
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Swap neighboring pieces in Space Adventure to form matching rows. Line up at least three candies of one color and remove them from the board. The puzzle presents its matching activity against an outer-space theme.

pages.title: Dashing Birds
pages.creator: OvenBakedGames
pages.description: Keep two birds clear of incoming missiles in Dashing Birds. Use the directional controls to shift them away from danger as attacks arrive. Collect stars during the attempt and work toward unlocking additional bird characters.

pages.title: Drive And Park
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Time sliding parking maneuvers in Drive And Park. Hold the control to bring a car into a space, earning money for successful parking. Travel between locations and build a collection of vehicles from the places you visit.

pages.title: Cubes Road
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Break away blocks to match approaching arrangements in Cubes Road. Inspect the cube patterns coming along the route and remove the appropriate pieces. The challenge depends on adjusting the shape in time as the next formation arrives.

pages.title: Modern Pong
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Keep the ball contained in Modern Pong. Tap to turn the circular arrangement and return the ball before it escapes the boundary. Each successful continuation adds to the scoring challenge as you work to preserve the rally.

pages.title: Cannon Shot
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Send balls from a launcher into a basket in Cannon Shot. Account for the physics of their movement and direct them toward the container. Meet the level's goal to continue to another arrangement requiring a different shooting approach.

pages.title: Magic Fairy Tale Princess
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Help Flora build a royal outfit in Magic Fairy Tale Princess. Choose among dresses, hairstyles, and accessories, then coordinate them into a finished look. The styling activity centers on making good use of the princess's extensive wardrobe.

pages.title: Pool Club
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Practice solo cue sports in Pool Club. Set the direction and power of a shot, then strike the white ball to send other balls into pockets. Work on lining up useful angles as you continue clearing the table.

pages.title: Run Santa!
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Jump across platforms in Run Santa!. Collect candy canes to increase the score and pick up springs that allow additional midair jumps. Keep the holiday run going without falling onto the hard ice below.

pages.title: Sushi Ninja
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Slice flying food in Sushi Ninja. Swipe the mouse or your finger through sushi to cut it, but keep away from bombs mixed into the action. The challenge is to continue slicing the food without triggering an explosive.

pages.title: BTS Swan Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Create colorful bird illustrations in BTS Swan Coloring Book. Choose a swan picture and fill its outlined areas using your preferred palette. Work on the drawing's details to make an individual version of the selected scene.

pages.title: Extreme Winter Oil Tanker Truck Drive
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Deliver fuel over icy roads in Extreme Winter Oil Tanker Truck Drive. Handle a tanker through snowfall and slippery, dangerous routes. Control speed and steering carefully so the oil reaches the people relying on it for vehicles and heating.

pages.title: Hungry Lilly
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Guide cheese to a waiting mouse in Hungry Lilly. Remove objects blocking its route and use the resulting physics to carry the food toward her. Try to gather all three stars without allowing the cheese to fall out of reach.

pages.title: Forest Bike Trials 2019
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Ride a trials motorcycle through woodland obstacles in Forest Bike Trials 2019. Use WASD to control the bike as you work through ten levels. Each course tests how well you can guide the motorcycle across its difficult barriers.

pages.title: Boeing Dreamliner Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild airplane photographs in Boeing Dreamliner Puzzle. Choose among six images and four layouts with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Fit the scattered sections together to restore the selected aircraft picture.

pages.title: Trucks Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble vehicle images in Trucks Puzzle 2. Six truck pictures offer four piece counts, allowing you to choose between simpler layouts and one-hundred-piece puzzles. Arrange every section to complete the chosen image before trying another difficulty.

pages.title: Prince Drag Queen
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give three royal characters glamorous party looks in Prince Drag Queen. Experiment with wigs, makeup, high heels, and outfits while preparing each prince for the themed event. Coordinate the available fashion pieces into distinct drag styles for the group.

pages.title: Soccer Blazt
pages.creator: vaisaga project
pages.description: Mix special powers with one-on-one football in Soccer Blazt. Play against a friend or the computer, choosing from a cast of powered characters. Disrupt the opponent with abilities while trying to score enough goals to win the match.

pages.title: Happy Glass Online
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description: Draw a route for flowing water in Happy Glass Online. Place a line that directs the stream into the empty glass and fills it again. Each level changes the arrangement, asking you to create a workable channel through the scene.

pages.title: Plane In The Hole 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Pilot and fire at obstacles in Plane In The Hole 3D. Move with WASD and shoot with the spacebar, managing both flight and the rhythm of your attacks. Unlock additional planes whose firing capabilities change the shooting experience.

pages.title: Big Chungus Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Help a rabbit complete colored shooting challenges in Big Chungus Bubble Shooter. Aim bubbles into matching formations and clear the targets as you work toward the Easter-egg trophy. Accurate placement matters when choosing where to send the next shot.

pages.title: Jump Bottle
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Time a bottle's jumps between surfaces in Jump Bottle. Use the platforms to keep it moving upward and collect coins along the way. The arcade challenge centers on landing safely and continuing the sequence of jumps.

pages.title: Glamorous Winter
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create cold-weather looks in Glamorous Winter. Choose dresses, coats, shoes, and bags, then coordinate the pieces into complete seasonal outfits. Experiment with the wardrobe's combinations to give the character a polished look for winter.

pages.title: Hungry Fly
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Guide an insect to food and back to safety in Hungry Fly. Collect sugar while avoiding spiders, webs, spray, and other threats around the route. Reach the exit without letting those hazards turn the fly's meal into a fatal journey.

pages.title: Sara Shopping Dress up
pages.creator: Yolkgames
pages.description: Help a shopper choose her look in Sara Shopping Dress up. Browse the character's closet and combine clothes into an outfit for the trip. Compare the available pieces to create a complete style before she heads out shopping.

pages.title: Beach Bar
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Run a seaside drinks business in Beach Bar. Move between tables, the counter, and the dishwasher to serve customers and keep the operation organized. Handle tasks promptly so guests remain happy and the bar can succeed.

pages.title: Avie Pocket Birthday H5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Prepare a celebration in Avie Pocket Birthday H5. Help Avie visit the market to buy the products she needs, then use them to cook birthday food. The activity connects shopping for ingredients with getting the party meal ready.

pages.title: Tower Takedown
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a bamboo-wielding panda dismantle a structure in Tower Takedown. Strike the tower while keeping the character clear of the sections that threaten to fall on it. Continue attacking without letting the collapsing structure end the attempt.

pages.title: Kitty Cat Power
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Create a superhero look for a feline character in Kitty Cat Power. Choose fashion items that suit the cat's powered-up identity and coordinate them into an outfit. The game centers on styling the character rather than managing a battle.

pages.title: Supermodels Unforgettable Vacation
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Prepare three friends for a snowy holiday in Supermodels Unforgettable Vacation. Join Olivia, Lily, and Angie as they travel to Winter Land. Choose fashion combinations for their unusual vacation destination and help complete each character's cold-weather look.

pages.title: Ice Queen Twins Family Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Combine housework and baby care in Ice Queen Twins Family Day. Clear dirty diapers, remove dust, and clean the windows before preparing milk and changing the twins. Finish by playing with the babies after their care needs have been handled.

pages.title: Baby Princess Bedroom
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a nursery interior in Baby Princess Bedroom. Help the young princesses choose floor and wall colors, then add furniture to complete the room. Combine the decorative options into a finished bedroom for their baby sister.
